habilidades.texto_en: Choose to wear armor or forgo it. Wearing armor grants bonus Health and Protections , while forgoing it grants bonus Strength and Movement Speed . • Swap between armor states by using Basic Attacks while the Passive targeter is active inside the Fountain.

Punch forward with your shield, dealing 100 + 0 [80% Strength] Physical Damage and Stunning enemies in a short cone. The force of the shield radiates further, dealing reduced damage. • The radiated force deals 80% Damage. • Non-God targets take 115% Damage. • Increased Stun duration when Armored , increased Scaling when forgoing your Armor .

You are blessed by the Gods, gaining bonus Strength , Protections , and Crowd Control Reduction for a short duration. Damaging enemies with abilities during this time Heals you. • When Armored , the Gods’ blessings also grant you a Physical Shield. • When forgoing your Armor , hitting an enemy god with your attacks from behind reduces their Protections.

Dodge in your current direction and ready your spear to strike enemies for 65 + 0 [45% Strength] Physical Damage . Hitting an enemy god with the strike allows you to recast the ability once before it goes on cooldown. • When Armored , striking an enemy god with your spear Slows them, stacking up to 2 times. • When forgoing your Armor , the speed of your dodge is doubled.

Prepare briefly, then Dash forward, dealing 180 + 0 [100% Strength] Physical Damage to enemies and Executing gods that are low health. Killing a god allows you to recast this ability up to five times. • Each kill exposes your heel, increasing your damage taken.

Hitting an enemy with a Basic Attack provides 1 stack of Combustion. Hitting an enemy god provides 2. At 4 stacks Agni's next Flame Wave or Rain Fire will ignite all enemies hit, dealing 5 + 0 [6% Intelligence] Magical Damage every 0.5s for 3s. When Agni kills an enemy god, he goes on a Hot Streak. When on a Hot Streak, Combustion is fully charged and using Flame Wave or Rain Fire does not consume Combustion.

Summon a cloud of noxious fumes which deals 10 + 0 [5% Intelligence]Magical Damage every second. Hitting the fumes with any of your other abilities detonates the gas, Stunning and dealing 20 + 0 [20% Intelligence] Magical Damage to enemies in the area. • Reduces enemy Healing
Summon a wave of fire, dealing 100 + 0 [65% Intelligence]Magical Damage . • Ignites Noxious Fumes

Dash forward and leave a trail of fire behind you. Enemies that enter the area take 20 + 0 [15% Intelligence]Magical Damage every .5s for 2s. • You are Displacement Immune while Dashing • Ignites Noxious Fumes
Summon a meteor, dealing 115 + 0 [60% Intelligence]Magical Damage . You can have up to 3 charges of this ability. • Ignites Noxious Fumes

Exhume decaying corpses at will. When you walk over a decaying corpse, reduce the Cooldown of Undead Surge and Corpse Explosion by 1s, restore 4% of your max Health and 3% of your max Mana. • Enemy gods and the Fire Giant can destroy corpses with 2 Attacks • You can have up to 6 corpses (45s max duration); placing more removes the oldest

Raise up to two decaying corpses from the underworld that surge forward, exploding on contact, at max range, or when you reactivate Undead Surge , dealing 90 + 0 [35% Intelligence] Magical Damage . Enemies hit are Slowed and have their Healing reduced by 25% for 5s. Corpses collapse after exploding and remain behind.

Fire a wraith forward. Enemy gods hit take 10 + 0 [10% Intelligence] Magical Damage every second for 5s and become haunted. • No Cooldown; you start with 2 Wraiths and can have up to 2; every 3 corpses consumed grants a Wraith. • Each time you damage a haunted enemy, spawn a zombie that runs to collide with them; zombies deal Magical Damage equal to 1% of your max Health and apply stacking reductions to Strength , Intelligence , and Protections , up to 5 stacks • Zombie hits cannot Echo

Throw a charm from the underworld that awakens a decaying corpse, applying miasma to enemies in an area. The corpse falls to the ground and remains behind. Enemies take 24 + 0 [16% Intelligence] Magical Damage every 1s for 4s. After the duration, enemies that healed while they had this effect take 65 + 0 [50% Intelligence] additional Magical Damage and are Stunned .

Unleash a field of spirits at a target location for 6s. Enemies inside the field take 50 + 0 [20% Intelligence] Magical Damage every 0.5s. • Each tick applies stacking Healing Reduction and Damage Dealt reduction (up to 3 stacks; stacks last 5s and refresh per tick) • After casting this ability, your next 3 Attacks also launch a zombie; zombies leave decaying corpses behind on impact

Make 3 wishes at any time. Gain a charge of Genie’s Strength every 10s (-1s per enemy slain, -5s for gods). • Wish: Wealth. +250 Gold. +10% Gold Gains. God Kills/Assists grant +33 Gold for 3m. • Wish Immortality. While dead, instantly revive. Gain 75% Movement Speed for 10s when leaving fountain. • Wish Power. Reset ability and item cooldowns. Gain a charge of Genie’s Strength.

Fire 5 Kufic symbols dealing 35 [33% Intelligence and 30% Strength] Magical Damage in a cone. Charge to narrow the cone. Fully charged symbols merge, dealing 60 [60% Intelligence and 55% Strength] Magical Damage . • When fully charged the symbol travels further and hits a larger area • Use a charge of Genie's Strength to send symbols back to Aladdin, dealing 20 [20% Intelligence and 30% Strength] Magical Damage when small or 35 [40% Intelligence and 48% Strength] Magical Damage when large

Dash forward dealing 70 + 0 [55% Intelligence and 55% Strength] Magical Damage to enemies you pass through. • Deals 0.25% increased damage to enemies for each % Health below 50% • Use a charge of Genie's Strength to summon the Genie to unleash a flurry of 5 punches that deal 20 + 0 [15% Intelligence and 27% Strength] Magical Damage to enemies in front of Aladdin

Dash forward. Dashing into a wall causes you to run along it before leaping to a location, dealing 60 [70% Intelligence and 50% Strength] Magical Damage to enemies in the landing area. • Use a charge of Genie's Strength to call the Genie to slam down at the landing location. Enemies take 35 [20% Intelligence and 40% Strength] Magical Damage and are knocked straight up • Cooldown is reduced if you land on an enemy god

Throw the Lamp forward, dealing 150 [55% Strength and 70% Intelligence] Magical Damage and stopping on first enemy god hit. If successful, Aladdin and the enemy god are pulled into the lamp to challenge each other. • They gain a 10% MaxHealth Shield + 10% Current Health . Aladdin's non-ultimate cooldowns are reset. The target's non-ultimate cooldowns are halved • The Lamp is left behind, allowing any god to enter the lamp and join the ongoing challenge.
Basic Attack or damage an enemy with Dazzling Offensive 3 times to illuminate their weaknesses, causing them and other nearby enemies to take more damage from all sources.

Heal yourself for 15 + 0 [3% Intelligence] over 4s, and alternate between the Gold and Red buff effects. • Gold buff provides a Health Shield for 6s on activation, and a persistent Movement Speed Buff • Red buff provides an Attack Speed buff for 6s on activation, and a persistent 12 + 0 [5% Intelligence] Strength and 18 + 0 [3% Intelligence] Intelligence Buff

Charge your Mirror for 5s and decrease all damage you take while charging by 15 + 0% [5% Intelligence]. Reactivate the ability to fire a projectile that deals 80 + 0 [60% Strength and 60% Intelligence] Physical Damage to enemies, increased by the Mirror's charge amount. • Deal and take damage to charge the Mirror • Base Damage is doubled when Mirror is fully charged • Base Damage increased by 15 against minions
Silence enemies in front of you for 1s, then dash forward and deal 80 + 0 [60% Strength] Physical Damage . • Pierces through and damages minions but stops on first god hit

Become CC Immune and then attack 3 times to deal 100 + 0 [45% Strength and 50% Intelligence] Physical Damage to enemies in front of you each time. • Attacks deal more damage and have bonus effects on each subsequent successful hit • 2nd hit deals 1.2x damage and Slows by 30% for 2s • 3rd hit deals 1.4x damage and Stuns for 1.5s
Dealing Damage to enemies reduces their Physical Protection .
Summon an obelisk, surrounded by shifting sands. • Enemies in the sands are Slowed and take additional damage from your basic attacks • The obelisk acts as a Wall
Throw a large spear, dealing 125 + 0 [90% Strength] Physical Damage in a line. • The first God hit is Pushed • If the God hits a Wall, they are Stunned
Leap forward, dealing 90 + 0 [75% Strength] Physical Damage where you land. • Knock Back all enemies from your landing point

Hurl a series of empowered spears, each dealing 80 + 0 [45% Strength] Physical Damage . • The final spear deals a burst of 150 + 0 [114% Strength] Physical Damage • These spears pass through everything • You are CC Immune while using this ability

Gain 2% Lifesteal and 5 Protections (+0.5 per level) Gain bonus Lifesteal and Protections scaled from missing Health . • Gain 1 stack per 10% missing Health • Bonus caps at +4% Lifesteal and +16 Protections at 20% Health

Locusts fly from your mouth, repeatedly dealing 15 + 0 [16% Intelligence] Magical Damage in an area in front of you. • This is a Channeled ability • You are Displacement Immune and move at reduced Movement Speed while Channeling
Fire a bandage projectile, mummifying and Stunning the first god hit. • This ability deals 60 + 0 [55% Intelligence] Magical Damage , only to gods
Summon allies from the underworld, dealing 25 + 0 [35% Intelligence] Magical Damage repeatedly to enemies in an area. • This also Slows enemies in the area

Your piercing gaze burns enemies in a line. • This deals an initial burst of 140 + 0 [90% Intelligence] Magical Damage • Then Channels to repeatedly deal 27 + 0 [18% Intelligence] Magical Damage • You are CC Immune and The Scales is at maximum stacks while using this ability
Gain Physical Protection and Magical Protection for each friendly or enemy god nearby.
Fire a kiss projectile that deals 60 + 0 [40% Intelligence] Magical Damage and Charms each enemy hit then Links you to them. • A Link holds up to 8m, then starts to break

Deal 60 + 0 [50% Intelligence] Magical Damage , Slow , and Push away enemies around you. •If you have a Soul Mate, Deal 60 + 0 [30% Intelligence] Magical Damage , and Slow enemies hit. If an enemy is hit by both areas, they take reduced damage from the 2nd area.

Fire a doves projectile that deals 10 + 0 [5% Intelligence] Magical Damage repeatedly over time to enemies hit. •On fire, Aphrodite and her Soul Mate start Healing repeatedly for 10 + 0 [7% Intelligence Self, 7% Intelligence Ally] over time, and have their active cooldowns decreased per tick.
Fire a kiss projectile at each enemy within 8m, dealing 100 + 0 [75% Intelligence] Magical Damage and Linking you to them. • Each Link holds up to 8m, then starts to break

Gain a stack of Audacity for each successful Basic Attack on any enemy and for each successful damaging ability on Enemy gods. At 10 stacks you gain 100% Attack Speed and Increased Basic Attack Projectile Speed for his next 5 Basic Attacks.
Send a projectile forward that deals 90 + 0 [90% Strength] Physical Damage .
Sing to Mesmerize all nearby enemies and gain additional protections . • Any damage done breaks the Mesmerize

Dash forward dealing 80 + 0 [70% Strength] Physical Damage and Knocking aside all enemies. At the end of the Dash all nearby allies gain a Speed Buff and all nearby enemies are Slowed . • Any enemy hit provides 1 stack of Audacity.

Ride your chariot across the sky, choosing when to land. When descending you deal 70 + 0 [25% Strength] Physical Damage every 0.15s for 0.6s, Knocking back enemies on the last tick. • 2 Allies can join the Chariot ride by interacting with his takeoff location. Allies have until Apollo reaches max height to join

Provide Strength and Intelligence in an Aura. • Build Protections to increase Strength Aura • Build Cooldown Rate to increase Intelligence Aura • Both Auras increase with Level • Allies gain 50% of the buff

Fire a Shackle projectile that deals 40 + 0 [25% Strength] Magical Damage and Slows . • You can refire after hitting an enemy god • Three Shackles may be out at one time • Gain Movement Speed for each Shackled god • Shackled gods take repeating 20 + 0 [15% Intelligence] Magical Damage and are Crippled
You and nearby allied gods gain Magical and Physical Protections and Basic Attack Damage . Ares gains bonus Health Regen . • Damaging enemy gods increases the duration and the effects of this buff

Flames pour from your shield, dealing 20 + 0 [7% Intelligence] Magical Damage repeatedly to enemies in front of you. • This is a Channeled ability, but you can fire Shackles • Deals bonus damage based on the enemies' maximum Health • You are Displacement Immune while Channeling • Reduces enemy Healing

Attach a chain to nearby gods, then Pull the gods toward you, and finally Stun enemies around you. • Deal 80 + 0 [30% Strength and 20% Intelligence] Magical Damage when Chains attach • Deal 250 + 0 [55% Strength and 50% Intelligence] Magical Damage to nearby enemies while Stunning • You are CC Immune and gain Damage Mitigation while using this ability
Artemis deals 15% increased Basic Attack Damage to gods and 30% to minions that are afflicted by Crowd Control.
Place a trap on the ground. Enemy gods that come in contact with it activate it, Rooting , Crippling , and repeatedly dealing 26 + 0 [30% Strength] Physical Damage over 3s.

Greatly increase your Movement Speed and Attack Speed . • On activation you are cleansed of slows and become Slow Immune for 0.6s. • While the buff is active, gain a charge each time you hit an enemy god with a basic attack. • After reaching 4 charges they are consumed, extending the duration of the buff by 3s.
Fire a volley at a target area dealing 100 + 0 [65% Strength] Physical Damage and Slowing enemies.

Summon the great Calydonian Boar that charges the nearest enemy god. • Deals 150 + 0 [90% Strength] Physical Damage and Stuns enemies. • The boar is immune until it hits the first god and then continues to charge other gods for its lifetime. • You are CC Immune for 1.5s after activating this ability.
When Artio hits enemy gods with damaging abilities, the target will begin to decompose, decreasing physical and magical protections. • The Protection Debuff effect stacks up to 5 times.
Artio swipes twice in front of her with her claws, dealing 40 + 0 [30% Intelligence and 40% Strength] Magical Damage to enemies with each swipe. • This ability applies Antiheal
Artio lets out a ferocious roar that Stuns all nearby enemies and increases her own Physical and Magical Protections for 4s.

Artio charges forward at an increased movement speed. Enemies she charges through take 75 + 0 [55% Intelligence and 85% Strength] Magical Damage and are Slowed for 2s. • Artio is displacement immune during this ability.

Artio summons a great bear spirit, which charges forward. Dealing 300 + 0 [40% Intelligence] Magical Damage and rooting all enemies in its path, as well as providing a shield and movement speed to all allies in its path.
After using an ability, your next basic attack becomes a ranged projectile that deals [125% Strength and 70% Intelligence] Magical Damage .
Charge up, then Dash forward. • Deals 80 + 0 [55% Strength] Magical Damage and Slows enemies • Gain Physical Protection and Magical Protection when you hit an enemy god
Taunt enemies in front of you. • Deals 40 + 0 [20% Intelligence] Magical Damage

habilidades.texto_en: Create a Phalanx of Soldiers that strike twice in an area. • Deals 60 + 0 [45% Intelligence] Magical Damage initially • After a brief delay, deals an additional 80 + 0 [55% Intelligence] Magical Damage • Applies a 20% Slow on each hit.

Teleport to the aid of target ally god, anywhere on the map. • Apply a 200 + 100 [15% MaxHealth] Health Shield and Movement Speed to your ally. • Deal 340 + 0 [90% Intelligence] Magical Damage to nearby enemies upon landing • You are CC Immune while using this ability

You gain Energy in your Astrolabe when you take damage from enemy gods or deal damage with your Basic Attacks or Abilities (minions grant reduced Energy). At 20 Energy, you may press your Interact key to unleash an Empowered Astrolabe Strike, consuming Energy. This does not trigger automatically from your next Basic Attack. • Empowered Astrolabe Strikes deal Basic Attack Damage + 8 Bonus Damage per Level in an area, with increased swing time; enemy gods are Trembled for 2s and minions are Stunned • While your Astrolabe is deployed with Unburden , your Empowered Astrolabe Strike resolves at the Astrolabe's location, dealing 3 times Basic Attack Damage to enemies around it • While you are holding your Astrolabe, Empowered Astrolabe Strikes damage enemies in front of you • You can store up to 30 Energy • You gain Energy faster from enemy gods than from minions

Throw your Astrolabe to a target location, dealing 60 + 0 [40% Intelligence] Magical Damage and Slowing enemies for 2s. While deployed, your Basic Attacks cause explosions at the Astrolabe that deal 23 + 0 [600% Level] Magical Damage to enemy gods (reduced to minions) and cost Mana per explosion. After 5s or when you refire, the Astrolabe returns. • While the Astrolabe is deployed, gain 5% Bonus Movement Speed • Gravity Pull changes based on whether your Astrolabe is deployed or held

Pull enemies toward your Astrolabe. Enemy gods who are too close are pulled into it. If you are holding your Astrolabe, you become Knock Up Immune , and enemies pulled into the Astrolabe are held in front of you before being launched in the direction you are facing. If your Astrolabe is deployed, held enemies are launched toward you from its location. • Pull deals 50 + 0 [35% Intelligence] Magical Damage ; launch deals 50 + 0 [35% Intelligence] Magical Damage

Dash forward, dealing 80 + 0 [40% Intelligence] Magical Damage to minions and cleansing yourself of Slows . Each allied god you pass near is cleansed of Slows and gains Movement Speed . While dashing, you are Slow and Knock Up Immune . Hitting an enemy god releases an explosion that Slows ; each Slow you cleanse from an ally during the dash strengthens that explosion's Slow , up to a maximum. • Movement Speed to allies: 25

Tear open the sky and call down a Gamma-Ray Burst. Enemies in the area take Magical Damage every 0.5s and gain Radiation stacks that reduce their Protections and Power . After 5s or when you refire, the burst focuses into a traveling beam that deals heavier damage and applies Focused Radiation . • Area tick: 35 + 0 [10% Intelligence] Magical Damage • Focused beam: 120 + 0 [40% Intelligence] Magical Damage • Max Radiation stacks: 5 • Each stack reduces Protections by 5% and Power by 3%

If you have not taken or dealt damage in the last 5s, gain 25% increased Basic Attack Power and Strength for 4s if you strike an enemy first. • The buff is extended by 2s if triggered by the leap from Summon Suku
Mount your Panther Suku, gaining movement speed but decreased strafe speed. You may Leap off of Suku to deal 80 + 0 [80% Strength] Physical Damage in the target area.

Flip over the last enemy you hit within 1.5s, Rooting , Crippling and dealing 50 + 0 [45% Strength] Physical Damage to them. The damage dealt is increased by 1.35x or 1.9x based on the next attack in your Basic Attack progression. • If the next attack is your third attack, you also hit all enemies in the area around the target

Suku comes to Awilix's aid, rushing forward dealing 90 + 0 [70% Strength] Physical Damage to all enemies. If hit from the side or behind, enemies are also Knocked Up . • This ability can be used while riding Suku

Pull the closest enemy god to you that is either Knocked Up or Leaping . The target god takes 170 + 0 [65% Strength] Physical Damage and is Stunned when they land. You are then bathed in moonlight, gaining bonus Attack Speed, Basic Attack Power, and Strength, as well as protection against Roots, Slows, and Displacement for 6s.
As you become more Drunk, gain Strength, Intelligence, and Protections . • You become Tipsy at 30% Drunk • You become Smashed at 60%, doubling the buffs

Take a drink, Healing for 0 , and becoming more Drunk. • You also gain increased Strength and Intelligence • Your next basic attack deals an additional 0 + 0 [0% PhysicalProtection and 0% MagicalProtection] Magical Damage

Smash your jug of wine, dealing 230 + 0 [65% Intelligence] Magical Damage and Intoxicating enemies around you. • If you are Smashed, gain Strength and Intelligence in anger over your lost wine

Damage applies Hysteria , granting your abilities bonus effects when enough is applied. Your team can also purchase Baron's Brew from the item store. • Gods at Max Hysteria [70] deal 20% Reduced Damage to Baron Samedi • Baron's Brew can be thrown at enemies to apply Magical Damage and Hysteria

Call spirits that deal 85 + 0 [80% Intelligence] Magical Damage to enemies in an area. • Hitting a god Heals nearby allies for 40 + 3 + 0% [10% Cooldown Rate] Missing Health • Hitting a god above 30 Hysteria makes the heal apply a 25% Speed Buff and Slow Immunity

Throw a snake that constricts enemy gods, Slowing them to a Root . • Constricted gods take 90 + 0 [50% Intelligence] Magical Damage over 1.75s • Minions take a tick of Magical Damage when the snake passes through them • Hitting a god above 30 Hysteria causes the snake to explode when it Roots , applying a Mesmerize to nearby enemies

Open a Coffin that Vortexes enemies towards Baron Samedi. Gods Vortexed into the Coffin take 200 + 0 [70% Intelligence] + 10 + 0% Max Health [2% PhysicalProtection and 2% MagicalProtection] Magical Damage and are Stunned . • The Vortex deals 15 + 0 [7% Intelligence] Magical Damage every 0.5s • Gods above 30 Hysteria are Vortexed with more intensity • You gain damage reduction while Channeling
Bastet gets bonus Lifesteal when hitting enemies. Enemy gods hit grant Strength and are revealed to you for 6s. • Grants 2 + 0.5 per level Strength • You can have up to 3 stacks of Strength .

Leap to a target location, dealing 95 + 0 [90% Strength] Physical Damage to enemies in the area. For 4s, reactivate to Leap back to your initial location. You gain 25% Movement Speed while you can return. • Cancel early to put this ability on Cooldown
Swipe at enemies in a cone, causing them to Bleed for 30 + 0 [22% Strength] Physical Damage every 0.66s for 2s.

Send a cat forward. If it hits an enemy, it Roots them and nearby enemies for 0.5s and deals 55 + 0 [60% Strength] Physical Damage . The cat persists for 4s or until defeated, attacking nearby enemies for 20 + 0 [30% Strength and 30% Intelligence and 30% InhandPower] Physical Damage and applying a Slow for 2s. • Cat attacks once per second • Cat is immune until it hits an enemy or reaches max range

Once it reaches that location, quicksand forms under the enemy, creating a Vortex that Pulls targets toward the center and deals 15 + 0 [15% Strength] Physical Damage every 0.5s for 3s.

Lash out with your Scourge to deal 80 + 0 [50% Strength] Physical Damage and Disarm enemies. • Change to Scourge basic attacks • Your basic attacks Heal you

You and nearby allies take reduced damage. Deal increased damage to enemies that damage you or your nearby allies.
